title: Optimization with SpotOptim
abstract: arXiv:2604.13672v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The spotoptim package implements surrogate-model-based optimization of expensive black-box functions in Python. Building on two decades of Sequential Parameter Optimization (SPO) methodology, it provides a Kriging-based optimization loop with Expected Improvement, support for continuous, integer, and categorical variables, noise-aware evaluation via Optimal Computing Budget Allocation (OCBA), and multi-objective extensions. A success-rate-based restart mechanism detects stagnation while preserving the best solution found. The package returns scipy-compatible OptimizeResult objects and accepts any scikit-learn-compatible surrogate model. Built-in TensorBoard logging provides real-time monitoring of convergence and surrogate quality. This report describes the architecture and module structure of spotoptim, provides worked examples including neural network hyperparameter tuning, and compares the framework with BoTorch, Optuna, RayTune,

translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.13672v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：spotoptim包在Python中实现了基于代理模型的昂贵黑盒函数优化。基于二十年的序列参数优化（SPO）方法论，它提供了一个基于克里金法的优化循环，具有期望改进、支持连续、整数和分类变量、通过最优计算预算分配（OCBA）实现噪声感知评估，以及多目标扩展。一个基于成功率的重启机制检测停滞，同时保留找到的最佳解决方案。该包返回与scipy兼容的OptimizeResult对象，并接受任何与scikit-learn兼容的代理模型。内置的TensorBoard日志记录提供收敛性和代理质量的实时监控。本报告描述了spotoptim的架构和模块结构，提供了包括神经网络超参数调优在内的实例，并将该框架与BoTorch、Optuna、RayTune进行了比较。
tldr: 该论文介绍了spotoptim，一个基于代理模型的Python优化包，通过克里金法、期望改进、OCBA和多目标扩展，并配备重启机制和实时监控，以高效优化昂贵黑盒函数。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces spotoptim, a surrogate-model-based Python optimization package that employs Kriging, Expected Improvement, OCBA, and multi-objective extensions, along with a restart mechanism and real-time monitoring, to efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions.
